banco_oraciones.oracion: Good morning, my name is Sofía and I am glad to see you.
Good evening is the polite greeting when arriving after six o'clock.
Have a wonderful day at the design studio, Kenji.
Good night is not a greeting when you enter a party.
We do not say 'until tomorrow' in natural English conversations.
I am not doing well today because I have a cold.
How are you doing this morning, Ben?
Are you having a good afternoon so far?
Shall we say goodbye now or wait for the teacher?
Are you doing well today? Yes, I am.
Is 'Good evening' used when you arrive at night? Yes, it is.
Do native speakers say 'Good night' when saying hello? No, they do not.

interaccion: Sofía: **Good morning**, Ben! **How are you doing** today?
Ben: **Good morning**, Sofía! **I am doing well, thanks**. **How is it going** with the studio?
Sofía: Fantastic! Look at the time, I must go to my meeting. **See you later**!
Ben: **Have a nice day**, Sofía! **Take care**!

Sofía: Let us meet at three o'clock. See you later!

reading.texto: Every morning at eight o'clock, Sofía arrives at her design studio in Medellín and says, 'Good morning everyone!' Her colleagues reply warmly, 'Morning, Sofía!' During the day, clients visit the studio, and Sofía always greets them politely with, 'Good afternoon, welcome to our studio.' When leaving the office in the late afternoon, she never says 'good night' to people who are still arriving. Instead, she smiles and says, 'See you tomorrow, take care!' In English, choosing the right greeting for each moment of the day builds trust and strong relationships.

preguntas.afirmacion: Sofía arrives at her design studio in the morning.
Sofía says 'Good night' to clients when they arrive in the afternoon.
Sofía says 'See you tomorrow, take care!' when leaving the office.
In English, greetings change depending on the time of day.

cast_dialogue.linea: Greetings and farewells bring warmth and rhythm to every English conversation. Choose your words with care for each hour of the day.
Good morning, everyone! How are you doing today? It is wonderful to see you all.
Good morning, Sofía! I am doing very well, thank you. Nice seeing you again!
Hey guys, good afternoon! I am off to Cartagena soon. Have a great day and take care!
Good evening, my dear children! Welcome home. And when you leave tonight, sleep well and good night!
